text:
I only came here because I wanted all you can eat crawfish. The crawfish weren't bad but everything else was. The blue crabs were not fresh. I could taste the ammonia and bitterness, basically the crabs were already dead when they were cooked. The oysters were jelly like, just don't eat it. The little neck clams were gritty. Sushi was over stuffed with rice.

Also you had to pay upfront and the machine asked for tip, which I thought was very rude since we haven't even gotten served yet. I clicked no tip. When we were leaving, the waitress looked at the receipt I had left on the table and saw that I didn't leave any tip and told me to leave some. That rubbed me wrong again. I hate it when the first thing waitresses do is check for how much money they made while rushing you out the door and expecting tip. I most always tip 18-20% but this time I did not because of the attitude.

To make matters worse, 24 hours later, me and my family who came with me, all three of us, got food poisoning and bad runs, on Christmas Eve, too! (Went on the 23rd). So terrible. 

Ick, what a trash dump. What did I expect for $14 a person? You get what you pay for!!
This was and awesome mexican restaurant.  We both really enjoyed our meals. This restaurant will definitely be one of our staples!!! Love, loved it

This place is taking Covid very seriously! Lots of hand sanitizer every where and social distancing and masks enforced. Came here for appetizers and drinks... The tots are delicious! Pictured is the Winter Mule.

I stopped here a few weeks ago on a whim to have dinner. They had two little bijou outdoor tables and I just thought, wouldn't it be nice to enjoy the autumn air and have a meal? I'm so glad I did.

I'm under the impression that the menu I ordered from was a temporary situation being done all outdoors on a grill, so you may not be able to get the dishes that I had if you visit in the future. I will say that my server was an absolute delight. If I could magically replicate her and have her be a server at every restaurant in the world I would. And not to sound like I'm bragging, but I tipped accordingly and I hope you do the same.

There were three skewers on offer: shrimp, mushrooms and chicken. I ordered one of each and honestly the mushrooms were underwhelming, but the other two were superb. I also had a burger that was one of the best burgers I've enjoyed in my life.

It looks like they've shut down for the time being due to Covid, but as soon as this place is open again I look forward to trying the regular menu.

Came to Reno to help my brother move back to Vegas and before I went to Reno, I marked Pangolin Cafe as one of the places I must visit (other than Lake Tahoe lol). I'm really glad that I went! I had a pleasant visit~ I believe one of the owners was the first one to help me with my orders. We ordered the cubano, iced matcha latte and red lavender iced latte and they were delicious~ I especially liked the red lavender! My brother enjoyed the cubano~ I originally only ordered a pound of the Turkish delights to bring as souvenirs for my love ones back home, then the owner gave us free samples of the Pistachio Pomegranate, lemon and grapefruit... after finishing the samples and the Hawaiian we came right back in and bought another 2lbs lol! I was afraid they were going to be too sweet (too sugary) but they weren't! They were very subtle and balance! Haven't tried the rest of the delights, but I'm sure they'll be amazing like the ones my brother and I tried! I wish they had branch in Vegas... this was my first time having Turkish delights and I'm glad I had at Pangolin Café!

I ordered a two topping pizza and 2 salads tonight to go . 
When I went to pick them up I went to the restaurant bar as always . The guy that took my order was on the phone . 2 different waitress came by and asked what I needed . When I told them I was picking up an order I was told I would have to wait for the guy on the phone . So 7 to 10 minutes later I was helped . The order was sitting on a bar table out in the open . The pizza was cold , floppy and not even cut all the way through . 
The amount of toppings on this pizza were a joke . You get more toppings on a 5.00 dominos . 
When I called to tell them all I was told was sorry give us another try .  Wow ! 
I sure miss the old staff .  Jonnie , Chrissy , and most of all Bill . I bet Bill would be horrified with the food and the service I received . 
I have been a life long customer.  I have seen the decline in a his location unfortunately it is not he closest  one to where I live . 
 Don't know if I will give it another try .

I've never been disappointed by this place. For a good old fashioned burger, try The Joint. It's big enough for two, or one if you're a growing boy like myself. If your feeling more adventurous, try the tuna burger. It's a generous portion that is seared to perfection and served on a potato bun with ginger. Think of it as sushi on a bun. Oh, and don't forget about the truffle fries!

Used to go there with my coworkers for lunch all the time. Really good tacos and quality service overall, plus, reasonable prices. Big party friendly, but parking might be a pain like everywhere else on Mass ave. Worth visiting over and over again!
Very nice clean restaurant, sushi was good ... my favorite was the miso soup. Absolutely delicious. Very friendly professional staff. Will definitely be going back !

Walking into this place is like walking into a prison or a 3rd world shithole. The establishment is unkept and disgusting. The employees are rude and ignorant. 
I walked up to the counter to order a mocha frappe and the female ex con with all the face, neck, and hand tattoos told me I had to order from the kiosk. I told her that I just wanted a frappe. She said it didn't matter. I told her that she was going to put herself out of a job. Her and another female employee started laughing and saying how they didn't want that job anyway. After trying to complete my simple order at the kiosk it wouldn't except my coupon so I had to go back to the counter and have ger take my order anyway lol. She struggled for several minutes to try and type the order in. Then started getting an attitude when she asked if I wanted peppermint or caramel. I told her it was a mocha frappe. She then said that they don't sell mocha frappes. I walked out...

Pappy makes em happy, what else can I add, glad they opened up the other side, the ribs are what you're here for, if you're out of town that's the kill shot. 

Haven't been here in 6 yrs and it's still the same, line is about the same speed, love Pappy's always worth a stop.

FRIGGIN AWESOME!  A lifelong Camden resident recommended Donkeys to us years ago, but we never found ourselves near enough to try it.  Spent a day in south Jersey and went to Donkeys Too and it was as good as we heard.  Total dive off the beaten path in a small, tired, neighborhood shopping strip and we were a bit leery of what to expect.  Went during COVID so takeout only.  Counter staff was incredibly friendly and helpful and our group ordered various types of steaks, fries and onion rings.  A bit different than your typical Philly steak so I won't give it a true comparison, but man this is an incredible sandwich.  Anthony Bourdain has this as one of his favorites and it's one of mine now too.  LOTS of meat, load of onions and a great Kaiser roll.  If I had to put any negative spin on it, just a hair too much salt, but that's being highly critical. Fries and rings were just as good.  Doesn't look like much to eat in, but we're for sure trying the original Donkeys as soon as COVID will allow.

I Love Anthony's! Probably my favorite Italian restaurant ever. And now with the new dining room, I'm in heaven! This is the only restaurant where I have said, "give my compliments to the chef"! Their homemade tomato sauce is so delicious on anything. I could eat it with a spoon ! My favorite entrees are: chicken piccata and the respelles( crepes) with ricotta cheese. The house salad dressing is the only one I order and of course I love the different breads and rolls with dipping oil to start. We often take groups there and are always treated well regardless of our shenanigans! The waitresses are soo friendly. We mentioned it was our friends birthday and she brought out a nice dessert with a candle for us to share. So sweet and it meant a lot to our friend.  Any night any day is great! Try it! Yum!

I was in the neighborhood and heard some disturbing info about pests on the premises. I had to have the best hoagie & cheesesteak in South Philadelphia. Beware pests I'm still coming back! It's so good it makes you hum after every bite mmmm
So flavorful! Cooked perfectly and so many fun unique menu choices!! Definitely coming back for more.

This place decor is really cool inside. We were there at 8pm Sunday and there was live guitarist singing. He was super!

I had a watermelon salad which was awesome. Half order was plenty because I had churros for dessert. They were delicious. I wasn't thinking tequila caramel dip was going to taste good but I was wrong!  Wow. 

The guys had corn tortillas steak tacos and Shrimp tostadas. Presentation was nice but seriously these tacos were skimpy for my 17 year old boy. Needed to order another item which really adds up$$$$

Queso was very tasty too.
This place has great pizza. Definitely coming back for more. The garlic knots were amazing! I don't understand the low ratings.

Service was horrible - Salad bar had old food on it that was spoiled - Soup on the Salad bar has been there all day because it had a crust on it...dinner came out...ordered Prime rib and shrimp...they forgot the shrimp. Prime rib had no taste - this place has gone down hill FAST!! won't ever go back! and the prices went up!!! Not worth it!! How does this place stay in business??

Great local spot for tourists and people who live here. Bunch of mom and pop spots clustered in one tight space. There are so many different spots to eat. You could literally go restaurant hopping to each one. The place is packeD all the time and I only wish the place was bigger and opened for longer hours!

Becky made the best Vegetarian Parmesan Chicken I have ever had!!!  The veggies were excellent also.  They had a special of $6.99 for a main dish and two sides.  Nice portions also, you can't get a healthy meal like this for that price anywhere, ready to go for when you are on the run.  Highly recommend Earth Origins and their cook Becky!!!

We've come to Chilangos a couple of times now, and have yet to be disappointed. First the service is amazing.  Lesly has yet to let us down. Take her suggestions y'all!! We started with the Poblanqueso, and honestly I was afraid at first since it wasn't what I thought I wanted. But once I tasted it... wow! Then, she guided us to try the Molcajetes, and I can honestly say it was AMAZING! The chicken, steak, pork, and cheese in the middle is something that I have dreamt about since our first visit.  I have yet to find something that compares to it. We tried the flan desert this time... don't skip out on that, you'll regret if you do. 
I can't wait to come and check them out on a Tuesday, for their Taco Tuesday specials - $1 tacos and tequila shots!

Came by for lunch to try the BBQ. It was busy but they have a person writing your order on papers to hand to the guys making your lunch. The lined seem to move along pretty quick. We had small pulled pork sandwich with collard greens and coleslaw and burnt ends sandwich with Mac n cheese and green beans. It was good and the sides were good but a bit salty. The BBQ sauce on the table was also good. 
They have plenty of seating and self serve drinks. It has pictures from Tampa area from early years. They were fun to look at. I did not like the fact the trays you were given were very greasy. We had to wipe all the edges. If we are in the area we may try again and get the ribs.

All I can say is the customer service desk is rude as can be and they have no idea what customer service mean!!!  Saving you the long story but this was not the first time they were ignorant at the service desk!  This was my last and final trip after recent experience yesterday !!  Go to Safeway or Walmart!
Bum location with rude af employees. Waited for 10 mins at the drive thru speaker to order. Only for someone to rudely say "1 second" and then take 5 mins to actually take my order
Hands down the best pie I've had since moving here from Bensonhurst. Order it well baked and thank me later!

I didn't want a full meal here because I knew that I had big plans for dinner and it was already close to 5 pm but I did need a snack after finishing a five hour plantation and swamp tour without a full meal. I settled on a side of garlic mashed potatoes and I must say that they are among the best mashed potatoes that I've ever tried. Be warned, there is a slight kick to them but the heat was easily subdued with a glass of water and the flavor was incredible! My only complaint is that the amount was rather small for the price. At $6 for just potatoes, which are a notoriously cheap food, the quantity could have easily been doubled. The small cup was barely enough to fully enjoy and it left me wanting a second helping.

I ordered from there for take out  for my office  a few times...two out of four times they messed the order up...one time they left the bacon off of everything that included bacon another time I ordered tomatoes instead of potatoes...they forgot them and the coffee I ordered...I called they said someone would reach out or email me, that was almost two weeks ago, I've heard nothing but crickets...the food is good but the service is lacking. I think it's a hit or miss place based on my experiences.  Best of luck

Way over priced. The food was "meh". And quantity is small. In addition to small quantity and below average quality, they left out several items from my order. I called to figure out the food they left out and they said they'd call back and never did. I left a significant tip on a takeout order bc I know restaurants are hurting and then got majorly shafted.  So disappointed with this place. Go literally anywhere else.

Cute tapas place. Meatballs, mussels and flank steak small plates were all good.
The verano cocktail was also really good. My only gripe was the menu was a bit small.  Staff was friendly
Some of the most amazing tacos I've had 10/10 would recommend every taco. Service was amazing, atmosphere is great as well
Very great service,  but employees are very friendly, and their food is very good, especially their macaroni and potato salad  highly recommend
The night time menu is amazing. They have a great bourbon selection.  I vegan cornbread was ok. I have to go back for the full menu. The thrsh ribs were delicious, flavorfully and we'll marinated.

This was our first time eating at The Turning Point of Marlton and it definitely did not disappoint!!
It past the eye test as soon as we walked in the door and were greeted with a big smile and a big welcome!! We were seated immediately rite near the fireplace which was perfect because it was very cold and snowing. Within a  minute Cassidy was at out table with a pitcher of lemon water and to take our coffee order. Then when the breakfast came we were totally satisfied with presentation, quantity and the quality was awesome. Thank You to the whole staff especially Cassidy. 5 STARS

Absolutely ridiculous Mexican restaurant. You do not get chips and salsa now until you place an order and after your first basket they charge $1.99. Tonight a friend of mine found a rather large piece of a Saran Wrap like material somewhat folded in half his enchilada.  We reported it to the owner.  When our bill came all that was deducted was $1.20!!  Unbelievable!  We spoke with the owner who suggested he didn't know why that was in there because according to his cooks they do not have any product with such material attached to it; we pressed him on if he was suggest we planted the greasy piece of wrap.  He stood by his statement and offered no other compensation and refused to own the problem.  With 5 guests whose bills collectively were a decent amount the owner felt a $1.20 discount was reasonable.  He even questioned why we had waited to report it. My friend had just tried to cut into that half of his last enchilada when he pulled out the wrap...it was then we called the owner over to report it.  Do not eat here!

Worst meal.  Paid $38.95 each for "All-you can eat crabs". 
Cold crabs, soggy french fries, and even inedible cole slaw, very salty butter. We're not complainers, but the whole experience, including the service, was awful and very disappointing.

Bamboo bistro always hits. They are options for everyone. I like to start with scallion pancakes and my favorite entrees are the chicken fried rice, and all time favorite is the general Tsos tofu! Even better than the chicken general Tsos, it's crispy , comes with a lot of tofu some brocolli and you get a side of rice. Yushiang brocolli is also good side addition, while it's broccoli and seems healthy it is drenched in sauce so good to be aware of. The sushi is fine , but for the cheap price for sushi I would say it makes it better. Takeout is super easy and relatively quick as well. Solid Asian cuisine at bamboo bistro.

Yum! I had a super nice dining experience here with my husband on Saturday night. I got the seafood combination pad Thai which was $15.95 and had scallops, shrimp, and squid. I asked for spicy and they delivered. Man it made my nose run which is just how I like it. The portion was huge too. My husband got a Panang curry with tofu and the portion was also very large and came with fresh pieces of vegetables and a side of rice. We would definitely come back. Service was decent too

Waited over an hour for take out they said would take 15 minutes.  Very frustrating 
Not the best service in general

I have tried to give Caviar and Bananas the benefit of the doubt because it's so convenient and the inside is really cute. But the food is so subpar and highly overpriced for what you get. The service really isn't bad in terms of the employees they are usually friendly but god is the food terrible. Picture of my "sweet potato and kale hash".

LET ME TELL YOU.. This place couldn't be more of a friendly atmosphere to go along with its unbelievable menu. From the signature Bloody Mary to the savory food items, this place MADE our vacation! Make sure to ask for Tim because this manager/server took his job to the next level! What's the real reason people go out to eat? It's not just the menu; it's the service! And this guy wrote the book on making a simple breakfast an experience of a lifetime. Absolutely a must visit place in New Orleans even if you're not staying in the hotel. Literally ran to my room to write this review. Great job Tim, we'll be back for you!
Excellent. Never eaten in, but picking up the "Meat Me" has become a tradition. I'd recommend trying out different sauce options.

I love eating at Zaxbys until today. I picked up a 20 piece tender meal and nibbler for my family and when I got home there was no nibbler and the tenders were burned. I called the restaurant amd spoke to the manager who had a very i don't care attitude. She offered me a tender meal even though i explained i had 20 tenders that were inedible. I questioned what she said and she was like oh they were burned. She obviously didnt listen or care. Very disappointing. We live too far to just go back. She did put me down for a replacement 20 tender but the lack of caring is very disheartening.

I thought the bakery items were nothing but sugar, shortening and flour.
The morning cakes I got were wet from being frozen and had absolutely no flavor. The chocolate frosting didn't have real chocolate in it.
I gave 2 stars because the girl at the counter was very nice.

Salt is a great restaurant. The calamari and rock shrimp appetizers are perfect! Also the sweet bread with orange honey butter is to die for! As my entree I got the yellowfin tuna steak which was phenomenal with this soy sauce. Overall, great dining experience with helpful and friendly staff.

Always delicious! I've been ordering from the Grog for years and they have never disappointed me. Even now ordering take out, the fries are still fresh in the box and the burgers aren't soggy like other take out places. It's perfect and a great price for high quality food. I very much recommend the truffle fries, you can't go wrong.

The manager at this Wendy's really needs to be removed this guy looks like he's high all the time every time you complain to him he has a 9 to lock added to the employees there they look like they're high all the time they need to come in and fired a entire Workforce that's in that restaurant because the service is horrible there's slow their obnoxious when you confront them about the time-consuming way that they serve you the drive-thru is horrible they're running out of ingredients all the time and then never getting people's orders right I always come back and I have to come back to correct an order this place is in serious disarray avoid at all costs

Was in this local Chinese buffet last Saturday and wow is it still an amazing value. Still tons of hot and tasty appetizers,entrees , and deserts. Still all the wings you can eat . Courteous staff. No designer interior but bang for your buck it is truly exceptional. It's nice that you can rely on some things not changing over time. My regular go to Asian buffet since my first posting and visit several years ago. Even the grandkids love it.

This is not just the worst meal I've ever had in NOLA, it was one of the worst meals I've ever had anywhere. The gumbo was roast beef gravy with, I shit you not, two shell-still-on crab claws and pasty rice thrown in. Fried tomatoes with shrimp roulade? Mealy pink tomatoes from the back of the fridge with some mayo soaked cocktail shrimp on top. And, for the love of god, don't get the potato salad. Barely thawed hash browns mixed with more mayo and some hot dog relish, served on top of bagged iceberg lettuce mix. No matter how much day drinking you've done, no amount of inebriation can make a meal here taste good. Somehow, the check was still $80. Do yourself a favor, go literally anywhere else. Save yourself!

We only stopped in for a couple of drinks. Loved our waitress - I get the feeling it wouldn't take long for them to feel like a regular. It's definitely divey and I can't speak for the food, but we had a fun time.

I am visiting from out of town and decided to have brunch with my siblings and mother who also traveled from out of town. The server was pleasant in the beginning, the food took about 45 minutes to come out. She took all of our orders accurately, so we assumed. We learned almost immediately that wasn't the case. Every person who ordered steak, their steak was over cooked. My wifes food had hair in her food and they still charged her for the meal. Two out of four  steak and eggs meals were supposed to be comped due to being overcooked and the manager still charged us for 3 of them. They totally forgot the kids food and they received their food late. We also went back and forth with the manager 4 times and he still insisted the outrageous total was accurate. It wasn't. After still paying the price we noticed we were STILL charged for 3 steak and eggs and taxed twice. Worse experience at a restaurant ever and I am a chef. I wouldn't recommend this place and the manager is horrible !
the staff does not change gloves  when handling food and money.  very unsanitary and does not follow covid19 guidelines.

Hands down one of the best steak houses I have ever been. What a treat. Yes it's not cheap but worth every penny. It's is a wine and dine restaurant. Take your time and enjoy. Caviar is amazing.  What a place

I went to Cold Spring Tavern for the first time ever this last weekend! There was live music and the atmosphere was amazing. Riley was our server and he did an awesome job with a rather large party. We did not make reservations and the staff was very welcoming and accommodating. I got the vegetable omelette with the biscuits and gravy and it did not disappoint. The food was delicious and everyone at our table was please and satisfied with their food. Thank you Riley for being so attentive and taking care of us. Great place to celebrate to a birthday especially after a weekend of hiking and camping. It hit the spot. The bar outside the main restaurant is very cozy and I recommend taking a walk around the surrounding area, very neat!

What a great diner! Great food and excellent service (thanks Jennifer)! I had the spaghetti marinara and it was very good. My wife had the grilled chicken sandwich that was also very good. The star in my opinion was my sons hamburger, oh man was it super delicious!!!

Overall just not good. You will not get good customer service here, food takes a really long time to come out, you're rarely acknowledged by your server, even as you walk in you're kinda just stared at. Food was good but just overpriced. Plenty of other good breakfast and brunch spots in Tucson. Go elsewhere..
Great service and always fresh food. The vegetarian burger is amazing and my favorite  don't forget the custard  especially with blackberries
Really good pizza but like most pizza joints in New Orleans crust barely has a yeast taste. But overall a good pizza, if ordered to be delivered can take a while.

I had breakfast special, chicken and waffles Benedict. It came with roasted potatoes which were okay. The chicken, waffles and eggs Benedict were very tasty. 

The service was excellent!
Delicious penne carbonara and angel hair pasta with marinara cream sauce! We got it delivered (Covid safety) and it arrived piping hot with DoorDash. Excellent price and excellent pasta.

There is so much to love about this place.  The food is great. The chips served with your meal may be the best I have found.  Not really an authentic place but definitely a great Tex-Mex option.  I love all the hot sauce options. 

Service is always great, food is brought out hot from the kitchen right when it is ready. 

Everything about this location and its employees is way above anything you expect from fast/casual dining.  Its a great hidden jem.

Tips: Busy location
Outside seating
Reasonable prices

I love the retro f50s style rustic atmosphere.The soups and steaks are tops. Cooked just the way you like 
I had the 20 oz T-bone, seasoned and cooked, medium well. Fantastic!
I substituted steamed veggies for fries and couldn't have been happier.
Great food at fair and reasonable prices.
I'll definitely be returning here.

This place was so good. The waitress was so sweet and she was doing her job very well A+ service and the food was DELICIOUS. I had the Caesar salad and my wife had the breakfast combo. Hands down best place I've eaten in Reno to date. Highly recommend
A hole in the wall place with great food at an affordable price! I recommend the pork rolls and chicken fried rice. I was satisfyingly full!

They're doing a great job during this pandemic. We've had it twice and both times was the pick-up instead of curbside so we could get margaritas to go. The margaritas are great, I highly recommend the strawberry. As far as food, I wasn't impressed with the enchiladas with mole sauce I got it even the tamales (i expected corn not with ground beef). The casa burrito and the al pastor tacos were both 10/10. In fact I was so disappointed with my mole meal last time that i almost passed on it as takeout tonight, but the al pastor tacos were their saving grace. They weren't too dry but not dripping either and double tortilla'd. The cheese dip is always great and the guacamole is worth every penny.

What a super find! We stopped in here for lunch when the Thai joint we wanted was closed, as it was a Monday. I'd seen the signage from the road that this place was new, but hadn't stopped in. So glad we gave it a try. The special sushi rolls are creative, food was fresh and it was delicious! They also have a very well-priced lunch menu for $8.95, with a good amount of choices, if not the fancy rolls. I can't wait to go back for dinner, and try more of the tasty creations.

I was craving pasta again tonight so I opened my Yelp app to see if Olive Garden in Deptford was open & to my delight, the app said open til 10pm!  Yay!!

I called ahead & gave my name & cell number to get on the list. I got a text message mins later from the restaurant telling me to show my phone when we arrive. 

Hubby & I hopped in our SUV and were there in 15 minutes.  Good thing I called to get on the list bc they were turning ppl away that hadn't called ahead. We saw a pretty large group including kids trying to walk in (without masks) and they were quickly turned away. 

Hubby & I waited in our truck until my phone was notified our table was ready. 

What an awesome system they have. I really appreciated that, especially bc I have a compromised immune system and can get sick very easily.  

The staff all wore masks, kept everything clean & had tables socially distant.  I had no worries!  Hubby and I had a great dinner!

Thank You Olive Garden for keeping us safe while allowing us to come out and enjoy eating in your restaurant!!

5 STARS ALL THE WAY!!!

The best salads in Nashville! Love this local business in Southeast Nashville. One of the few if not only places serving a healthy and vegan type menu. They offer a selection of green vegetables salads, pasta salads, potatoes and wrap sandwiches. They are reasonably priced and serve ample portions. All the items are made to your preference. Yep, "you can have it any 
 way you like".. The ingredients are fresh and plentiful. They offer different salad blends, choices of meat (chicken, steak, salmon, etc., lots of vegetables toppings and an array of dressings. The inside in spacious and clean. Great for a group or dining by yourself. Great to visit during COVID. The tables were spaced out. The staff and patrons all wearing masks and practicing the safety protocols. Last,  the salads come in medium and large. They servings are large enough to share or have leftovers. Friendly service and great all round business. I highly recommend.

Soooo happy to be writing this. I have been wanting to visit Capital Tacos  for a while now, but the 4th st location was just too inconvenient. I went months and months hearing my coworkers and friends rave about it, and planned to eventually make a trip over there.

However, a few weeks ago, I see a sign for capital tacos right by my house. And bam-- a new location opens up right behind tyrone mall! I couldn't wait to go in and try it out, so I came in opening day. 

My boy friend and I made sure to order a mix of things-- salad, burrito, taco, queso, chips-- and get a feel for the place. We ended up loving everything! Flavorful and fresh are the two words I would use to describe the food here. There wasn't one bite we did not enjoy.

We will definitely be returning soon, as the drive is literally a few minutes from our house. I'll be dreaming about CT until then!

Delicious good!

Ordered lunch here for 6 of us last Friday.

We ordered the Diablo Shrimp ( 4 orders) and the Carne Asadas ( 4 orders) plus I also ordered 12 fish, 12 chicken and 12 beef tacos.

I like to eat!!

Everything we ordered was delicious and very tasty!

The shrimp plates were very tasty and spicy hot with flavor.

The carne plates were perfectly cooked with nice tasty tender pieces of beef.

Everyone thoroughly enjoyed the tacos too!

Come here for some very delicious Mexican food!

I used to be French trucks biggest fan. I praised them to anybody I met and would rave about literally everything on the menu. Unfortunately I moved away for a year, and upon my return - French truck is not the same :( not only did I pay 15 dollars for two regular sized lattes with regular milk and no substitutions, but they've also replaced their yogurt - which may not seem like a big deal - but let me tell you this was devastating news to the many people I informed about this. I mean - we went for the coffee, but we REALLY went for the yogurt. I actually have an air b&b for two months around the block from this French truck, and had been anticipating making this yogurt part of my daily routine - however now I'm not sure what I'm going to do  certainly not force myself to eat this watery overpriced ex-favorite of mine.

We recently discovered this place and it is incredible. The burgers are some of the best in the city and we love the variety of options for toppings. Their fried chicken sandwiches are awesome too. Highly recommend!!!

The food was pretty good. The service definitely could have been a little better but it was super busy so it was understandable. I know this place is known for their hurricanes but I did not enjoy them at all. There's not a very good balance of liquor and mixer and i just felt like I was drinking from the mouth of a liquor bottle. Still a good experience and atmosphere!
Pleasantly surprised at the quality of sushi this place has. The chef is passionate. But unfortunately can only serve sushi in the evenings.

Thoroughly enjoyed my first visit at BurgerBarr!! I ordered The Blend Burger  and it was absolutely delicious!! My husband ordered the I'mpossible Burger (in which I was extremely surprised he chose a meatless option) and he Loves it! I took a bite as well and I thought it was tasty!! Definitely will be back!! Oh and the staff was extremely friendly and helpful!!

Really good experience overall, but fried items I got were greasier than I'd like - thus the 4 stars. 

Coconut almond shrimp $21 regular vs $13.95 early bird (but smaller portion - one shrimp less) - got the latter due to the huge price difference. It was ok, not sure I'd order that one again. Plump shrimp, but greasier and not as flavorful as expected. 

BEST deal though? $3 off all appetizers from the regular menu until 7 pm aand you get full size of the item for almost the same price as the smaller early bird version once everything is said and done. You just miss out on the small salad, but still a GREAT deal. Go for this!

Best mussels I have ever had btw - they were ordered by somebody else, so I didn't take a picture. But oooohhhh... I really wish I would have ordered them instead of the coconut shrimp! The broth was so delicious I wanted to drink it out of a glass, haha! So light, yet flavorful. Big portion out the apps menu, and with $3 off during happy hour, it's also a steal.

Drinks: $1 off wine,  $2 off wells on special. I got one of the $5 sangrias (red and white avail) aand that was good.

Service by Peter was outstanding. Ask for very fresh bread and you shall receive (and it's free)! Way better as it is so spongy, yet crusty when you order it fresh. If you don't ask for it you prob won't get it, so please keep that in mind.
We prefer ex catering g for our Christmas party and it was the best barbecue I've ever had. The sides were fresh and homemade and every part of the meal was outstanding

We sat right down. Our waitress was rude. I had a made a comment to my kids that I didn't want them drinking all their milk so she (the waitress) took it upon her self to not bring my kids milk. Finally when their food comes she's brings it explaining (while mocking me) she heard what I said about them not drinking it all up. Anyways that wasn't her place she should have brought the drinks out with everyone's. The food was okay I swear my biscuits were underdone. The bacon was pretty Amazing and the cinnamon roll pancakes. 35.00 left full but annoyed.

First meal when I got to Philly was Cleaver's. The first bite of the hot fries was amazing (probably because I was starving). However, each bite just got worse and worse. The fries were doused in so much hot sauce that I felt like I was drinking hot sauce in every bite. The fries were soggy and lost their crisp because of the hot sauce. That was definitely a disappointment.

I also ordered The Block, which was pretty average. There was barely any cheese, which I was sad about. I even added extra cheese to my cheesesteak. The bread was like french bread, so it was more tough. The meat was plentiful, and the pepper and onions added to the flavor. However, nothing about it was outstanding. I am not sure if I had a bad batch, but Cleaver's may not be my go-to for cheesesteaks.
One and done. If you like Robert Orr Cisco bland this place is for you. The person that took our order was very nice and everything seemed clean.
Decent.  Good ceviche.  Hardly any crab meat in Seafood Louis Salad.  They need to do a three job on take out food consistency.  Overall, pretty good,

I was bringing my mother in law out for dim sum and this place had more vegetarian options than most of the other restaurants in Chinatown so we decided to give it a try. I went to their NYC location and loved it there so had high hopes for this one. The food and service was just ok, while the prices were higher than average. Tea is $1.50 per person but they won't allow you to have different types of tea? So odd. Tea is usually charged by the pot so for 3 people It costs $4.50 for tea and we still couldn't choose more than 1 Kind. I liked that they took reservations on a Saturday afternoon, which is unheard of in other dim sum restaurants in chinatown. 

All of their dim sum dishes are just ok, other places in the area have better variations. The one exception was the snow pea and shrimp dim sum, that was delightful. I tried their famous OG egg roll and it was just ok, nothing to write home about. It tasted good but wasn't amazing. My mother in law ordered the pan fried crispy noodles and it was really just stir fried noodles. The vegetarian dim sum was tasty per my mother in law. 

I would say if you are really jonesing for dim sum and don't want to wait an hour on a weekend in Chinatown, then try here. If not, check out the numerous other options Chinatown and the Northeast have.

Are you OBsessed with Ranch? Have you always dreamt of trying 13 different styles of your favorite condiment? If you said yes to one of these, this is your place. Twisted Ranch is such a cool concept and has so many cool things to try on their menu.

   One BIG tip that I can give is to come as soon as they open, if possible. We kind of did this on accident, and were very lucky to be seated right away. Moments later, this place has a line out the door!

   Of course, the main reason to come here is to get their ranch sampler. You get a little turntable with 13 different ranch flavors, from sweet, to spicy, to just plain odd and interesting... and a big basket of fries is placed right in the middle. 

   My eyes are bigger than my stomach, so I could've been satisfied by the fries alone. But I also ordered some wings, which were also great and you can pick any kind of ranch to go with it. You can also buy whatever flavor you want in a bottle to take home!!

  Really cool place, great service, great food....and SUPER fun!
No sub shop can top my grandparents' long closed Wilmington shop but this one comes close.
Had a late breakfast here with my mom today.  She loves it here.  Friendly service and out food came out quickly!
They guy that works the drive through late night is super rude basically talks to you like you trash
Great owner, staff is friendly and accommodating. Food was delivered quickly and hot! Plenty of Televisions for all sports viewing! Recommend highly!!!

I was in la Roca Saturday an all I can is if I can give this place a negative 0 I would. I was with a group of people we all ordered food. first off the waitress we had was beyond horrible. all she did was take our order an take off. Never asked us for a refill on our drinks nothing!! When I did see her , she was standing there talking an laughing with another female which I come to find out towards the end is the so called " manager ". I have now waited over an hour for my food so I see another employee I grabbed her to see what was going on with my food and she  immediately goes to the window and grabs my food. She is very apologetic an nice. I was not happy my food was cool  not hot . I advised her to get me a manger which she did. This women happen to be the one laughing and joking with my so called waitress. She comes over and yells at the employee that was helping me, which was extremely rude.  She was more helpful than anyone else. All I can say management sucks there as well as the server I had.
We had the "Burger Bus" food truck come out on Saturday for my dad's 60th birthday party and it was a big hit! The guys working were were friendly and worked super fast. We had a great experience!

Good sushi at an affordable price. It's a good alternative to my favorite casual sushi restaurant in South Jersey. HOWEVER, my biggest complaint is that the deluxe chirashi don at Ginza is always inconsistent. Sometimes they make it just like the picture on Yelp (expensive selection of sashimi, as it should be because that is what they advertised on their menu) but then sometimes they add in cheaper pieces (mackerel, white tuna) and omit the good stuff (yellowtail, uni, clams, etc). Sometimes I get more, sometimes less. I just want to get what I paid for, not hope for the best every time I order.

AMAZING FOOD. Fist off, they know how to cook a brat. I've never had bbq this good!!!!! I will Definitely be going back for more!!!! Can't wait to try the street corn !!!! You guys will see me often!!!

Hell, if you're looking for a burger - there's no other competition in the city. Port of call has the best burger hands down. The baked potato is also perfect every time (it's also one of the only restaurants in Nola that I've been to that serves baked potato). They have a menu but don't bother - order a burger and baked potato and enjoy. Also,  drinks are STRONG!

Great burgers! The rest of the menu is kind of lack luster though. Everything other than the burgers are just overpriced for the quality. Great beer selection and full bar.

The bartenders are great, but they don't train their servers very well. The food is inconsistent. The management doesn't really care. Sometimes the food is really slow. The bathrooms smell pretty gross (yuck!). Don't expect spectacular food or service. It's a good place if you're looking for cheap drinks and a laid back atmosphere. Also, do the yelp check in and get the free chili cheese fries. Those are pretty good.

Food, drinks and service were all decent.  However, the indoor seating set-up was problematic.  There were plenty of other tables so customers could all maintain a safe distance from each other, but they put everyone together in one spot for their convenience.....side by side.  I sent a friendly feedback on this through their website twice, but never heard back.

This place is *chef's kiss* no lie. I came here for restaurant week and had the best brunch for takeout!

I started off with the freshest guacamole and plantain chips that were made with the perfect crispiness. I also got to try some of the king crab empanadas, which were also juicy and flavorful.

I ordered the Argentinian breakfast, which had steak, two eggs, potatoes, and a side salad. Everything was cooked to how I liked it. The only thing was the potatoes were extra salty and the steak was on the bland side. But I guessed it worked out when you combine them for each bite. Mixto also have a whole bag of bread. I don't know what it was, but it was delicious.

My favorite was the dessert. If you know me, you know I'm obsessed with tres leches. So, I got a slice and ate it all even though I was already busting out the seams. The cake was not overly sweet, which was good because they would put the tres leches liquid mixture in a separate cup to pour over on your own. Definitely loved the experience for only $20!!

Cool atmosphere and clearly a local favorite, however I was a little underwhelmed by their mac n cheese (I believe it was pimento cheese based). I also got the duck pastrami sliders, which were tasty, but not as good as expected (white bread, pastarmi, and cheese.) Staff was friendly and food delivered quickly, I would consider going back and trying something else.

I have an excellent experience at Chipotle today and wanted to give kudos to the staff for friendly and pleasant service. 

I grabbed a burrito for lunch and was surprised to see no line. Next thing I knew my burrito was made, paid for, and I was out the door. Impressive speed!

There is a clean dining area if you wish to linger. 

I love chipotle because their ingredients are fresh and come with a number of quality standards. 

If you live between the university and this Campbell location I think you'll find this one on Campbell Ave to be a bit speedier and less crowded.

Loved the atmosphere, staff, and overall appeal of the restaurant. Unfortunately, food and beverages were subpar and made me and the others I visited with very sick. We had the jerk wings, crab cake sandwiches, and the jerk burger. The sangria was good but watered down. Paloma beverage was very salty.

This is our favorite Sonny's in the area! Staff and management are very accommodating, friendly, and professional. Tonight was no exception, especially with their special - all you can eat chicken for $6.99. We were just five of so many hungry people wanting to take advantage of this great value! 

All five of us had the special which started with a half chicken, 2 sides (corn on the cob, green beans, baked beans, macaroni and cheese, and cole slaw were our choices) and garlic/corn bread. We all agreed that the wings, thighs and drumsticks were moist and meaty. The breasts were a little dry, but good. The corn on the cob, baked beans, and macaroni'n'cheese were all hot and tasty. The cole slaw was not as creamy as it usually is, and the green beans were good, but a little over cooked. Still, we were full without getting more chicken. We did get an extra corn bread for 3 of us - so good! Better than the garlic bread. 

Before leaving, 3 of us also got drinks to go. Their drinks are jumbo sized, and we like the lemonade and tea. We are looking forward to our next meal here!

Nice location. Food had lots of color and was presented well.  Service was good as well. Ordered southwest salad, avocado toast, pancakes, and pastry. The salad dressing was good flavor the grilled chicken was bland and have tough spots. The avocado toast had a fair amount of butter with avocado slices.  This was odd to have butter with avocado.  Toast came with a poached egg but the egg had a fair amount of water with it still. Overall, food was tasteless and expensive for what you're getting.  I can't recommend this place. I gave it a try and was disappointed.

I've never written a yelp review, but this will be my first one from the amount of shock I just felt. This all you can eat dinner ($15.99) is actually the worst buffet I've ever had... the best thing I had was the broccoli in the beef and broccoli and grapes. There was some fried rice that was okay I guess. I tried to eat different forms of their beef and chicken. The beef in every dish was so overcooked and inedible that I had to stop. BBQ chicken was pretty okay. Salt and pepper shrimp was tasteless and overcooked/dry rendering it completely inedible. 
I ended up with a pile of everything I didn't eat on two plates. I tried some egg drop soup... and it tasted like grits? Nothing made sense here. Wouldn't recommend.

Maybe the worst restaurant experience ever. My husband has not been well and had been losing weight. But, he said he was hungry for chicken fried steak and mashed potatoes. A year or so ago we remembered he had had just that at the Logan's on Charlotte. We arrived and those out front had a two or three minute discussion about just where to seat us, the restaurant was nearly empty. Our waitress asked what we would like to drink. Wine for me and a large draft beer for him. We talked for a few minutes and then I went to the ladies room. On my way back to our table, I walked through the bar, which was nearly empty -- one man at the bar and two men at a table in the bar area.

Got back to our table and found our drinks had not been served. We chatted and 10 minutes later our drinks arrived. The "Big Draft Beer" my husband ordered was a regular -- read small here -- bottle with no glass. The wine was as ordered. Husband ordered a salad and it was served.  And then we waited, and we waited and waited. The waitress finally came to the table and asked if we were ready for dessert and did we want a box for the salad! I informed her we had not been served our dinner yet.
"Oh," she said, so she heads back to the kitchen. She came back to let us know dinner would be out in a few minutes. Ten minutes later my husband's order of the chicken fried chicken arrived, the "house made" mashed potatoes looked like Play Dough and the chicken was a long way from the crispy fried he remembered of a y

I was so excited to come to a restaurant under the Emeril franchise. First let me say how absolutely gorgeous this place is. It is the perfect environment for a romantic occasion or any special occasion really.  The wait staff was great. The live music (pianist/vocalist) was entertaining and really added to the ambiance.

Now here's the disappointing part. Personally, I had no issues with the food I ordered, but those in my party did.  The lobster bisque was apparently too salty. My friend asked for a replacement, and she received the gumbo in place of it. The gumbo was too salty as well and there was too much of this specific spice that is used in gumbos. Sorry, I can't remember the nsme. So that soup was also sent back. Another friend agreed the gumbo didn't taste right.

Another person ordered the gumbo, and he never received his. 

A 12 year old in our group ordered fries, and she received mac n cheese, which she ended up eating because we couldn't seem to get anyone's attention to take it away, and she said it tasted terrible. The order was never corrected, unfortunately. Another person in the group who ordered the mac n cheese agreed, let the server know, and asked the wait staff to take it away.  It wasn't a true mac n cheese. And by true, I mean, they used something like a cream sauce similar to Alfredo, not the stretchy cheese like gruyere, sharp cheddar, ect that are classic mac n cheese ingredients...it was dry...even our server joked about it looking dry by saying

Great beer, terrible service. Three people working and they each thought someone else was taking care of us since 1 seated us, 1 brought us water, and another 1 finally got us a beer after we flagged her down.  Finally the 1 they all decided would be our server came over and said "Sorry, I got real busy in the kitchen" while I had sat and watched her chit chat with the other 2 and NEVER stepped foot into the kitchen. They weren't busy. They just didn't feel like doing their jobs.
The beer was worth the drive, but the service guaranteed we won't be back.
Food was delicious, service was fast and friendly. Tables were not spaced out well, but it was a busy Friday night.

If you've never had Afghani food, this is the place to try. Have been here several times and everything is delicious. I highly recommend the Mantu which is the national dish of Afghanistan. And of course all the kebabs are fantastic.

I missed judged this "Italian Cafe" it's not a pizza place. Lots of grilled and sauted items. We had chicken marsala and a lobster ravioli with creme sauce. Both excellent. And we sat outside in a nice dining area my wife said was very disney Grand Floridian like (even with a bit a street noise). Highly, recommend TJs.

My favorite sushi spot in Tampa! I was hooked after trying the Honolulu Sunset roll on my first visit. Even though it is take out only everything is always packed up nicely to enjoy at home. Every roll I have tried here is great and like that I can get soy paper instead of the seaweed. I make the trip over from Clearwater just to have Kelp!

My husband & I are full time RV'ers, & we wish there was a Newk's in every place we land. The menu offerings are plentiful, & we love everything we order! The salads are fresh & flavorful, the soups are hearty & taste homemade, the pizzas are delicioso (the crust is divine), & the sandwiches are fantastic. There are lots of fresh breads from which to choose to make your sandwich choice perfect for you. There is a large selection of complimentary condiments on a centrally located table in the dining area. Sliced jalapeño peppers, olives, garbanzo beans, croutons, breadsticks, & other items add zest to your lunch or dinner. And, if you have room, the dessert offerings are amazing. If you have an opportunity to eat at Newk's, do it!!

Excellent resteraunt for a casual date or nice family dinner.
I have lived SB for 8 years and wish I had found this delicious resteraunt with really cool Mexican art incorporated into one of SB most unique resteraunt's year's ago.
I've had the mole burrito, steak quesadilla, and tortilla soup.  All of them tasted delicious and their soup menu is also something worth visiting the resteraunt: 
albondiga, pozole verde, and chicken soup.

The burgers are a bit greasy and they really ought to filter the water that they use in their soda machines.  There really is something about the water on this side of the town.  I've noticed it at several restaurants in the area, but after speaking with the managers of other business this is remedied with a better filter.  
In saying those things, my son is a fan so we are a regular every couple weeks. I just get picky with which burgers I pick so to avoid getting that extra grease. Try to stick with a single and do not grill or sautee any of the veggies.

I just moved from NYC to here and for the first few week when I was here, I went to several Chinese restaurant and it left me disappointed until I went to Cheng Du. The food in here is the definition of authentic Chinese food. The hot pot chicken, Dan Dan noodle, cumin lamb, they got all the Chinese food on the menu and a lot of time, they got daily specials that's not on the menu. When it comes to the price, trust me, it WORTH it and the portion is there too. Even tho this restaurant is known for there Szechuan spicy food, you can arrange the spicy level from none, 1-10.
I come here at least twice a week and the waiter is very friendly!!! 
Definitely recommend this restaurant over all of the Chinese restaurant in PA, yes Pennsylvania!!!

If I could give this place no stars I would, this place is the most disgusting thing I've ever tasted. My partner and I were so disgusted with everything. We order General tso chicken, crab cheese Wonton, pork fried rice and a egg role. Everything tasted spoiled and rotten. We contact grub hub which turned into this whole deal. The women at the front gave us the store owner number he was very rude and disrespectful we tried to speak with him, once he had enough he hung up the phone. Long story short, if you want to get food poising this is the place to go. Enjoy. 

Mirela
Cozy atmosphere. Extremely attentive wait staff. The food was magnificent. I highly recommend the West End plate and the French Onion Soup. Will be back, now that we have discovered this gem.

Went to Carmel Tattoo and piercing. Saw that there was mediterranean restaurant and decided to give it a try. It was a Sunday so a little quiet. We got the hummus as an appetizer and it was nice and creamy. I got a chicken souvlaki with rice and salad. Portions are great. I did wish the chicken was a little more moist.  Also ordered the lamb kofta. That was very good. Nice clean facility and staff. Would come back again if I'm in the area.
This is by far one of the best Thai food takeout restaurant's in the area. The food is great and the quality shines through. The staff goes out of their way for you . Highly recommend!

I love super spicy foods and fried chicken. But yo, Hattie bs has the absolute HOTTEST chicken you will ever eat. My first bite was the pickle slice on top of my chicken. I instantly started sweating. 2 bites into my chicken I had started crying. 4 bites in I felt nauseous and had already soaked multiple napkins in sweat. After the FIRST PIECE of chicken down, I was an absolute mess with major snot running, tears, gallons of sweat and a stomach full of burning coal. I think my body was melting on the inside. To be fair, they warned me against it.
The best tonkatsu I've ever had. They give you so much of the curry sauce they make in pair with it. It's so rich and flavorful.

Really tasty king cakes! The icing isn't my favorite but the bread and cream cheese filling are soooo good!!! I got mine from Flavors Snoball and they're stocked up almost every day or every other day!

This place did not disappoint!!! THEE best fried chicken I e ever had in my life!! Not greasy. And our waiter, AJ was very hospitable & knowledgeable... he made our experience one to remember!!! The pies and made from scratch ice cream were spectacular!!!
Great food, drinks and an awesome staff. Waldo's brought some good relaxed fast casual vibes that were much needed in my Germantown neighborhood. I get the Fowl Mouth sandwich almost every time.

This restaurant's food is absolutely incredible. When we have friends in town we bring them here and typically everyone remarks that it is one of the best indian restaurants they have ever eaten at. A must try!!!

Great cheesesteaks. One of the best in the city. I had a doctors appointment in the suburbs so I finally made my way out of Center City to try this place out in early winter. Let's get one thing straight, ordering and getting a seat are a mess. The inside is small, with one long counter and a few tables. You have to make your way to the front, order your food, and then wait for your name to be called when it's ready. Well there isn't anywhere to stand because this place is always PACKED to the brim. We finally got our order in and about 30 min later, we snagged a seat and sat down to eat. 

We got two things the Chicken Cheesesteak and Cheesesteak with beef, onions, provolone, mayo. The chicken cheesesteak was dry and flavorless, so that's a miss. At least the classic cheesesteak was delicious. The meat is finely chopped, almost like ground beef, but it was delicious. It's huge though, so I only ate half.

Overall
Chicken Cheesesteak 2/5
Classic Cheesesteak 4/5

Ok first all this place is a true hidden gem, and don't let the outside or decor fool you into leaving! You will want to park in the empty lot adjacent (left if looking at restaurant). The guys working are considerate, funny, attentive and the food is outstanding! You get to watch them prepare your food behind the counter, and let me tell you everything looked yummy. Not the typical Spanish rice, it has peas and carrots! At first glance I was like whoa that's weird... but it works!!! The street tacos are what I live for, the carne asada sooo good, not chewy or nasty, tender and perfectly seasoned. Be warned; this is not the McDonald's 2min drive through but the wait is worth it, plan on spending 45 min here. My only critique is perhaps an upgrade on the old fashioned counter chairs.

What a find!  I'm sorry we only found out about it a few weeks before we moved from the area.  Definitely has nice ambience, and the service was pretty attentive.  Portion sizes were pretty good compared to other sushi places I've been and the sushi itself was quite fresh.   I thought the rolls were pretty generous in size as well.   Interesting sake selection, was fun to try that as well.

If I'm back in St Pete and want sushi, i would absolutely come here.

This bar has come up with the most unique way to follow covid protocols by using moving pods as private dining rooms. Each pod has its own heater and curtains to help keep you warm in the cold weather. They now have plexiglass windows in your pods where servers can hand you your food and drinks. I got there about an hour after they opened (they opened at 5pm). I had to wait about ten minutes for a pod to open up, but they have a heated porch to wait under and gave us menus to look at while we waited. They do make sure to thoroughly clean out each pod after they are used. 

Now on to the good stuff! I ordered a Mai Tai and my friend ordered a Scorpion Reef. These drinks are STRONG lol. They also have a small selection of beer for people who don't like mixed drinks. The best part of my experience was the food. We ordered the mozzarella sticks ($10), loaded fries ($10), and split a burger ($8). The burger was literally one of the best burgers I've ever had. It was easily in my top 5 if not higher. I do believe some of the food comes from the restaurant next door called The Heartbreaker. My friend and I spent the whole ride home talking about how we can't wait to get another meal here.
Finally got the chance to try Verti Marte. The Jazz sandwich was super delicious and messy! Not an easy eat but the taste was so worth it. Plenty of mushrooms and meat! Would recommend!

Went here for dinner. Ate outside. Ordered the octopus appetizer. It was good and flavorful, but I would have liked the meat grilled more...it was a little soft.  Ordered the Taste of the Mediterranean appetizer pita plater...it was good, and u get a lot. For dinner, my friend ordered the gyro with fries. She said it was good. From what I saw, it lacked meat. But she really liked the fries.  I ordered the Santorini with Salmon. I liked the flavors, but thought the pasta underneath was greasy. But, I ate the food, took home leftovers, and finished them. Service was good.
Awesome little coffee place with picturesque motifs on the coffee froth. Ambiance was chill, and the snacks were Plentiful ... our group of 5 enjoyed this place very much.

Ive only been there once. It was the greatest single meal I've ever had in my life. It was 2012 and I got the braised pork shank over risotto. The food was incredible the atmosphere is wholesome and the grounds for sculptures near by is The most pleasant way digest the exquisite meal. It's not just a restaurant it's an experience

My husband and I regulars here. It's our favorite lunch spot! Their pizza by the slice is our favorite. The slices are literally the size of your face.

Being from just north of Chicago and Italian, I'm a pizza snob, and this place... I approve of!

Oh, and don't get me started on their garlic knuckles!
Food was ok. Service was ok, despite the restaurant being practically empty. Nice views of the river though!

I ordered it through Uber eat and ordered the vegetarian pizza with eggplant and it was very fresh and it tasted so good. It's the best delivered pizza i have ever had and I recommend it to others. And they taped the box to make sure the delivery person can't touch the food.
You will not find people who are passionate about their restaurant and food!  Go there. Great Sunday brunches.

I have had similar experiences that every other person that has reviewed this location has had. Long long long waits and you may or may not get the correct order and if you do it tastes old or burnt or both. They have run out of food with the store being open for several hours still. It's mind boggling that the location in Fairview heights blows this place away in quality. They really need a manager/ supervisor that takes pride in their job because it starts at the top. Employees could not give a shit less. Will not be returning to this location.

The new layout and remodel is great.  It really opened the place up...but now that week one is down after the Grand reopening, the kitchen and staff service really lack routine.

Let's get the glitter out of our eyes and get the food and drinks on the tables.  The service window is for food pick up, not social time and eating in front of the customers.

Great place, great menu and drinks...poor management.  Let's pick it up guys!

This place is pretty awesome. I only wish there were more places like it, or that Urban Fort had branches in various parts of the city! 

The ambiance is relaxing; let the kids place while the adults play! But, in all reality, you still need to keep an eye and hand on your kids because they ARE kids, after all! The play area isn't supervised by other adults. I feel that sometimes this place gets the reputation of being more of a drop-off, hands-off facility, which it is not! 

The lunch options were all health-conscious, tasty, and filling. But once you factor in the price of entering to play at Urban Fort, along with the to-be-expected prices of lunch, it's not a place to head for an inexpensive day out.

This is one of my favorite places to go for a quick lunch or dinner. I've yet to have fish that was not fresh. Nice variety of sauces. Their wonton chips are good on the side although you can add them to your bowl. The small bowl is quite filling with three proteins and a large variety of toppings to mix in.  Small place. Friendly staff. Usually busy during lunch.

They had a special with grilled cheese and tomato bisk, it was AMAZING. Realllly hoping that's added to the permanent menu, I cannot find a solid grilled cheese and bisk combo anywhere! The price was super fair too. Also the beer selection is solid and unique

I loved all the food and the sangria was to die for! I went with 3 of my friends and we had the Apple fritters for an appetizer, they are dense with chunks of apple through out them. Look similar to a hush puppy with a yogurt dipping sauce. My boyfriend loved them. It was a 12pm Sunday brunch date so service was a little slow and food took a while but it was well worth the wait and we understood quality food takes a little longer. We will definitely be back
Ohhh the crust actually has a taste! Always ready on time. Which it was cheaper for a whole pie...
Just ate  Thanksgiving cookies. Excellent balance. Not full of sugar just right. What a great old school  tradition.

Our waiter was not very kind to us. If we asked for anything, we would get eyerolls and genuinely felt unwelcomed. Aside from that matter, we tried to shake the treatment off and focused on what our family came here for: a good time sharing a meal. When it was time to pay, I noticed that the Items we ordered were being charged approximately 1.50$ MORE than what was reflected in the menu handed over to us in the beginning of the meal (I went back to the menu  just to double check). When I brought this up to the waiter, he indicated that the prices being charged on our tab were the "updated" prices. I then proceeded to let the waiter know that THIS IS NOT OKAY. When a person sits down to eat, they order with the understanding that the prices on the menu are the correct ones. If the customer is not made aware of those changes, that is dishonest and should be considered stealing. I completely disagree with the excuse of not having updated menus. I looked around the room and noticed everybody eating---how many of these people were being overcharged without them noticing???? I wondered if this was a scheme that our waiter was playing on us and his customers or if this was a scheme currently being played by the restaurant. We walked out of this restaurant feeling ultimately betrayed by the company's integrity and we definitely dont plan on returning here anytime soon.

They have put new meaning to skimpy. We ordered a ham and cheese Stromboli. Their regular one has 3 meats and cheese for $19.00. This is quite expensive but in the past the quality was worth it. NOT ANYMORE.
Our stromboli has 4 pieces of thin sliced ham in the whole thing and of course they still charged $19.00.
Even COVID is not an excuse for this blatent  price gouging!

I was very disappointed w my meal today. This place used to have great food, not sure what happened? Service was ok, they were trying their best w a small staff. We ordered meals for 2 adults and 2 little kids. Burger was dry and thin, the lobster in the sandwich felt like it had just come out of the freezer, fries were super greasy, presentation was lacking (some of the meals just looked like someone threw them together in a plate in the kitchen without even looking). Even the kids meals weren't very good. We expected more considering this was a $100 lunch and this place used to be known for great food. Also the bathrooms were gross, not sure how they weren't on top of that considering how few people were eating there. Hope this place gets their act together at some point, used to be a great restaurant.

Do not go to this location- stick to either the original location on Bustleton Ave or try the other location on Comly Rd, both off of the Boulevard. The Langhorne location is also good, I just prefer either 2 off the Boulevard. I repeat, do not go to the Center City location as you will be disappointed.

This should clear up a majority of the negative ratings for my beloved Prince as it is one of the best (if not the best) steaks in Philly.

What a wonderful experience.  We were greeted outside and were told the history of the building and the restaurant. The food lived up to the introduction. After dinner we were given a tour of the rest of the building. An overall wonderful experience.  We come back hear the next time I'm in town

Love this place! I've been for both dinner and weekend lunch now. Both great experiences. We were able to get in without a reservation both times but that was because it wasn't exactly during peak hours. On date nights, highly recommend making a reservation.

We were going to go here as it would have been my first time. Should've just left as soon as we realized the hostesses didn't care whether we were there or not. Not even a simple "we'll be right with you" after a 7 minute wait (because they couldn't be bothered, it wasn't busy) we get sat & wait for about a half hour & nobody came to offer drinks or introduce themselves! We left & went to Iron Hill Brewery where we received exceptional food & service. Didn't even tell the hostesses or anything just walked out. Sucks because I was certainly looking forward to trying this place now we'll never go back.

Hate when you call in a pickup order, and get home too find out they charged you for the 2 blue cheese but did not put them in the takeout order, when called the young lady's response was.... well their only .50 cents a piece. Yep pay them $15 per hour.
Great steak & wine. The Bolognese was bland, booths were uncomfortable and staff was very rude.
